arm_semantics.hegel_full: offline Hegel research with cross-task knowledge
arm_semantics.hegel_no_memory: offline Hegel research with memory disabled
arm_semantics.code_full: ordinary Python agent using gpt-5.6-terra with cross-task shared knowledge
arm_semantics.code_no_memory: the same gpt-5.6-terra agent with inherited knowledge and shared files removed

resource_contract: All four arms receive the same task order and per-task observation and measurement limits. Hegel research compute and Code host model-evaluation candidate-row counts are different measures; Code fitting and search within run are bounded separately by Python execution time. Equal numeric ceilings do not establish equal total computation. Terminal rows are withheld from learning. Code model calls, tokens and Python time are reported separately.
